subtitle: Lesson 4 · SQL Server Architecture

code:
SQLOS   thin layer inside sqlservr.exe

Scheduling     one scheduler per logical CPU core
Memory mgmt    hands memory to buffer pool, plan cache
I/O completion  async reads/writes, no blocked worker

Tuned for database workloads, not general fairness.
